scripts.pack: bun run stage && (cd build && gnome-extensions pack --force --extra-source=LICENSE --extra-source=types.js --extra-source=geometry.js --extra-source=keybindings.js --extra-source=quake-manager.js --extra-source=prefs .) && mv -f build/quake-anything@yccoskun.github.io.shell-extension.zip .
scripts.install-ext: bun run stage && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/quake-anything@yccoskun.github.io" && rsync -a --delete build/ "$HOME/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/quake-anything@yccoskun.github.io/"
